title: Way too many ads
body: The amount of ads on this app genuinely make it unusable. I understand that you want people to pay but this is rediculous. You get an ad everytime you click a button. After leveling up you can watch an ad to double rewards. If you click no, you will get an ad anyway but without any rewards.
